title: Shifted Symplectic Fibrations and Derived Thurston Theorem
summary: In classical symplectic geometry, under mild conditions, Thurston proved that one can construct a compatible symplectic form on the total space of a symplectic fibration with a connected symplectic base. Here we prove a derived symplectic analogue of this result, called the derived Thurston theorem.
